ModMetaData.name: RimArt
ModMetaData.author: vilasone455
ModMetaData.description:
Four genes, each granting an active ability that does something no other gene does.
CORROSIVE GLANDS - spit contact acid at a target's weapon and make them drop it. No damage: takes the threat off the field without taking the body off it.
HYPERMETABOLIC GLANDS - burn food reserves straight into wound repair. Runs until the wounds are gone or the food is.
ALARM PHEROMONES - force every hostile in range to break off and come for you, with a little extra toughness to survive the decision.
STASIS ORGAN (archite) - collapse a sphere of stopped time around yourself. Nothing inside moves or can be harmed, including your own pawns and the caster. What you buy is time for everyone outside it.
Requires Biotech and Harmony. No other DLC or framework mods needed.
